P3.2.text: is a full service network programming origination and distribution company, supplying an array of services to the cable, satellite and broadcast industries. AMC Global Media Broadcasting & Technology’s experience in program delivery in both high-definition and standard-definition is unparalleled in the industry. With more than 30 years of practical and theoretical experience, AMC Global Media Broadcasting & Technology employs first-rate engineering and operations staffs, as well as network services groups, including affiliate engineering, network operations, traffic and scheduling, that can provide seamless day-to-day delivery of any network.

P3.3.text: AMC Global Media Broadcasting & Technology is located in Bethpage, New York. This state-of-the-art technical facility consolidates origination and satellite communications functions in one 62,000 square foot facility – an industry first – and keeps AMC Global Media at the forefront of technology, providing both standard – and high-definition digital infrastructure.

P3.4.text: AMC Global Media Broadcasting & Technology’s current client base includes AMC’s own AMC, IFC, SundanceTV and We TV, as well as other premier clients including MSG Network, MSG Plus, MSG Varsity, Mid Atlantic Sports Network and SPORTSNET NY. AMC Global Media Broadcasting & Technology delivers services to these high-quality entertainment services 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

P1.2.text: Urban 1 is the largest distributor of urban content in the country. For more than 35 years, Urban One has been the leading voice speaking to Black America.

P1.3.text: As someone from Hong Kong, it s still kind of a secret to talk about ED or Viagra. There are a lot of men here who won t discuss it because they don t want to look good or ashamed. However, attitudes are slowly shifting. I remember a friend with ED who was at war with herself for years before coming out. His post Viagra Hong Kong relief was a visual as well as a psychological one. Its like, getting his confidence back. Such a personal anecdote illustrates not only how cultural stigma can make us put off help, but also how powerful the correct diagnosis can be.

P1.9.text: Odkryj magię gry w Vox kasyno, gdzie każdy spin może być początkiem wielkiej wygranej! Ta platforma to prawdziwa oaza dla miłośników hazardu online, oferująca nieograniczone możliwości rozrywki. Kolekcja automatów obejmuje zarówno klasyczne owoce, jak i nowoczesne video sloty z rozbudowanymi fabułami. Jackpoty progresywne regularnie osiągają zawrotne sumy, tworząc milionerów overnight. Gry karciane dostępne są w wersjach RNG oraz z prawdziwymi krupierami w studiu. Promocje sezonowe związane ze świętami i wydarzeniami sportowymi dodają dodatkowej pikanterii rozgrywce. System punktów lojalnościowych można wymieniać na prawdziwe pieniądze lub ekskluzywne bonusy. Współpraca z lokalnymi metodami płatności, takimi jak BLIK czy Przelewy24, ułatwia transakcje. Blog edukacyjny oferuje strategie i porady dla początkujących graczy. Transparentność RTP i regularnie audyty niezależnych firm testujących potwierdzają uczciwość gier.

P2.2.text: Our mission is to be the most trusted source in the African-American community that informs, entertains and inspires our audience by providing culturally relevant integrated content through our radio, television, and digital platforms.

P2.3.text: A Rich History and Iconic Brands.

P2.4.text: We are the largest distributor of urban content in the country. For more than 40 years, Urban One has been the leading voice speaking to Black America. First, as the largest local urban radio network. Then, as the largest syndicator of urban programming. Yes, we can even claim our position as the largest Black owned television network and distributor of digital urban content.

P2.5.text: Our brands are unsurpassed. Our content is relevant. Our reach is unparalleled. No other multi-media company reaches over 80% of Black America. We proudly wear our banner and lift our voice as we ‘ Represent Black Culture ’ boldly, courageously and unapologetically.

P2.6.text: Regardless of the medium, whether it’s TV One, Radio One, Reach Media, iOne Digital or One Solution, we create content that REPRESENTS a people whose impact has touched every fiber of American life. That’s what makes us experts. We are creators and distributors. We are developers and executors. We provide solutions to advertisers seeking a deeper customer engagement. And we are the answer for urban enthusiasts wanting content to satisfy their mind, body and spirit.

P2.7.text: ONE company serving a diverse people all seeking ONE thing…URBAN.
